name: Big Bend Recreation Site
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251842 (317 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: BLM Moab Field Office campground on the Colorado River along the SR-128 scenic byway, ~7 mi E of US-191. 33 individual sites plus 3 reservable group sites; fire rings, shade shelters. Large open riverside pads accommodate RVs. Group sites reservable online. --Claude

name: Maple Grove Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234302 (136 days observed, edges closes)
note: Fishlake National Forest (Fillmore RD) campground beneath red cliffs on Ivie Creek, ~4 mi W of US-50 on FR-101 (milepost 146). Several single sites plus 3 reservable group sites. Maple/cottonwood/oak shade; Rock Canyon Trail starts in the campground. --Claude

name: Ferron Reservoir Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232414 (109 days observed, edges closes)
note: Manti-La Sal National Forest campground on Ferron Reservoir just below the Wasatch Plateau ridge at ~9,400 ft, ~30 mi up Ferron Canyon on FR-022 (gravel). Developed single sites (max RV ~25-45 ft depending on site) plus a lakeview group site; vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups. Reservable online. Small-craft boating and trout fishing on the reservoir. --Claude

name: Gooseberry Reservoir Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232409 (168 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Manti-La Sal NF in an open meadow next to Gooseberry Reservoir, reached via FDR 124 off SR-31; 8 sites (rec.gov notes each has a lake view), vault toilets, no water/hookups. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Ponderosa (Uinta NF)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232231 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF, Spanish Fork RD, in Bear Canyon just off the Nebo Loop Scenic Byway at ~6200 ft; 23 single-family sites with paved roads and parking spurs. Salt Creek runs alongside (rainbow trout). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Payson Lakes Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232228 (132 days observed, edges opens)
note: Large USFS campground (Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF, Spanish Fork RD) on the Nebo Loop Scenic Byway ~12 mi up Payson Canyon, ~8,000 ft; ~90 single/double sites in loops A/B/C plus 3 group sites and 2 yurts. A loop is FCFS all season, other loops reservable (5+ days ahead); paved roads. Adjacent to Big East Lake. --Claude

name: Renegade Campground (Strawberry Reservoir)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233867 (89 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS (Uinta-Wasatch-Cache, Heber-Kamas RD) campground above Strawberry Reservoir at ~7,700 ft; paved loops/spurs, flush toilets, drinking water, boat launch nearby, no hookups; RVs to 30 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Aspen Grove Campground (Strawberry Reservoir)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232390 (94 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS (Uinta-Wasatch-Cache, Heber-Kamas RD) campground near Soldier Creek Dam on the Soldier Creek arm of Strawberry Reservoir at ~7,800 ft; paved roads/spurs, cement pads, flush toilets, drinking water, adjacent boat ramp; double sites take RVs to 60 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Green River Campground (Dinosaur National Monument)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234777 (126 days observed, edges closes)
note: NPS Dinosaur National Monument campground on a cottonwood-shaded bench along the Green River below Split Mountain (~4,800 ft), ~5 mi E of the dinosaur quarry. 80 sites for tents/RVs; RVs cannot fill tanks. Apr-Oct; Loop B reservable mid-May to mid-Sep, Loops A and C first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Shady Dell Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10048096 (123 days observed, edges closes)
note: Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF on the Mirror Lake Scenic Byway (SR-150) at ~8,200 ft, ~17 mi from Kamas. 19 single + 1 double sites, no hookups, vault toilets, water typically available. Lower Provo River accessible (trout fishing). Reservable. --Claude
